value.name: Daniel confesses taking the folder
value.description: Daniel admits that he went into the desk and took the green folder after Rosa's death.
evidence: "I went into the desk," he said.
"I went into the desk the morning after she died. Rosa was downstairs making coffee for the people from the funeral home. I went up. I saw the green folder. I — I took it."

value.name: Asha demands the folder's location
value.description: Asha asks Daniel where the folder is, pressing him for its immediate whereabouts.

value.name: Daniel reveals folder is in his car
value.description: Daniel says the folder has been in his car and that he only read the first page before hiding it away.
evidence: "Now. It has been in my car. I have not — I have not opened it past the first page. I read the first page. I read the part where it said *one-third to Rosa Maldonado* and I closed it and I put it in the glove compartment and I have not opened it again."

value.name: Asha confronts Daniel about concealment
value.description: Asha points out that Daniel has possessed the folder for six days and lied about the house being left to him and his sister.
evidence: "You have had it for six days."
"You had it yesterday when you sat at this table and told me the house had been left to you and your sister."
"You had it this morning when I asked you in the upstairs hallway whether you had taken anything from the house."

value.name: Asha silently lets the accusation land
value.description: Asha pauses and allows the implication of Daniel's deception to settle without adding anything further.
evidence: "She let that sit. She did not need to say anything about it. The sitting of it was the saying."

value.name: Asha orders Daniel to retrieve the folder
value.description: Asha instructs Daniel to go get the folder immediately and says Marcus will accompany him.
evidence: "I'm going to ask you to go and get it now," she said.

value.name: Daniel submits to the order
value.description: Daniel acknowledges Asha's instruction and understands the significance of Marcus accompanying him.

value.name: Daniel stands to comply
value.description: Daniel rises from the table, preparing to leave and retrieve the folder.
